english.title: Excess weight - permit use of locomotive / motor tractor / bus unladen weight not marked
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) permitted **(..SPECIFY PERSON..) to use on a road, namely **(..SPECIFY ROAD AND LOCATION..), a

(A)_[locomotive,]_
(B)_[motor tractor,]_
(C)_[bus,]_

namely **(..SPECIFY VEHICLE MAKE AND INDEX NUMBER..), which did not have its unladen weight plainly marked in a conspicuous place on the outside of the vehicle on its nearside
english.legislation: Contrary to regulation 71(2)(a) of the Road Vehicles (Construction and Use) Regulations 1986, section 41B of the Road Traffic Act 1988 and Schedule 2 to the Road Traffic Offenders Act 1988.

english.notes:
(i) See Regulation 71(1) for exceptions.
(ii) Statement of Facts procedure applies - see end of document for wording.
(iii) In the Statement of Facts if the weight was displayed, but in the wrong fashion, the place and mode of display should be included.
(iv) See also offence wordings: H301 and H302.
english.standardstatementoffacts: At **(..SPECIFY TIME..) on **(..SPECIFY DATE..) the defendant permitted a motor vehicle, namely **(..SPECIFY VEHICLE MAKE AND INDEX NUMBER..) on **(..SPECIFY ROAD AND LOCATION..) when the unladen weight of the vehicle was not plainly marked in a conspicuous place on the outside of the vehicle on its nearside .

other.penalty:
A fine not exceeding level five on the standard scale.

Time limit for prosecutions:
6 months

On the 12th March 2015 the limit on fines imposed by a Magistrates’ court was removed – as such, the potential fine on summary conviction in relation to an offence committed after this date is unlimited.
